# Jon Martin

> Jon Martin writes diagnoses of why systems and org structures keep breaking in founder-led professional services firms. He works in revenue operations — systems integration and subscription management, mostly for SaaS and professional services companies — and treats the job as variety management, not tooling. The Four Laws of Complex System Design is his standing reference on the systems theory (Ashby, Conway, Brooks, the Reverse Conway Maneuver, Beer's Viable System Model) behind that diagnosis work.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://thejonmartin.com/): Who this site is for and what a written diagnosis/second opinion is.
- [About](https://thejonmartin.com/about): What Jon does, why a second opinion rather than a project, and where the Four Laws framework comes from.
- [Writing](https://thejonmartin.com/writing): Essays on systems, complexity, and revenue operations.
- [Contact](https://thejonmartin.com/contact): Questions about the Four Laws framework, a correction to the reference material, or a consulting/speaking conversation.

## Four Laws — Interactive tools

- [Flow Formula Calculator](https://thejonmartin.com/flow-formula-calculator): Interactive Little's Law, Kingman's formula, and Weinberg's context-switching calculators.
- [Flow & Constraint Diagnostic](https://thejonmartin.com/part8-flow-diagnostic): A five-step guided diagnostic that produces a personalized Five Focusing Steps writeup.
- [Stakeholder Decision Checklist](https://thejonmartin.com/stakeholder-decision-checklist): A checklist for diagnosing why a decision is stalled on a client engagement.
